content.rendered:
Tired of planning what to do for dinner? Don’t want to worry about doing dishes? Join us at MOD Pizza, Wednesday October 2nd, for Dinner Night Out! Bring in the flyer, or order online through the MOD app or website using the provided coupon and MOD will donate 25% of your bill to support Hawks View Elementary!

Address: 21370 SW Langer Farms Pkwy, Suite 132 / Sherwood

Fundraiser Code: MODGIVES25

Thank you for your support!
